description: Creates the signed-in couple’s first wedding after explicit confirmation, using both partner names and an optional date, location and venue. Unknown date and location may be omitted. Existing weddings are returned without changes; accounts with multiple weddings are asked which to use. Creates a private preview with no membership purchase, site publication, partner invitations or marketing-email enrollment. Account sign-up happens in the secure browser connection, never through tool arguments.

confirmed.description: True only after the couple confirms creating their wedding with these details.

location.description: Chosen wedding location. Omit when undecided.

venue_name.description: Booked venue name. Omit if the couple has not booked a venue.

wedding_date.description: Wedding date as YYYY-MM-DD. Omit when undecided.

name: create_my_wedding
title: Create my wedding
